claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Glimepiride is a sulfonylurea that closes KATP channels via SUR1/SUR2 and is not expected to kill cancer cells at 2.5 uM; any antiproliferative effect would be weak and non-selective, likely reflecting off-target mitochondrial/lysosomal effects rather than a specific cytotoxic mechanism.
